liveHistoryPairing.source: Read-only OrderHistory and ShipmentHistory, paired by sourceIdentity next to raw message
liveHistoryPairing.notCompletion: Order-only and missing evidence do not prove distribution applied or omitted
liveHistoryPairing.layout: 1920x1080 left two columns pair raw message and matching history; whole order history is folded reference
liveHistoryPairing.polling: visible online screen only, bounded batch of 50, scope and identity response validation, last-good preservation

criteria.room: 영업방 exact name + server-configured room ID
criteria.upstream: dedicated authenticated /api/kakao/nenova-sales-feed only; no legacy unauthenticated fallback
criteria.cursor: afterKey is an external_message_id string of at most 512 characters with no control characters; initial cursor is an empty string, it is URLSearchParams-encoded, and nextAfterKey is a valid cursor string or null (null requires hasMore=false)
criteria.messageId: upstream message id may be null; source identity remains source + chat_id + external_message_id
criteria.selection: explicit user text replacement; no automatic analysis or registration
criteria.applicationStatus: one scoped batch GET joins only exact sourceIdentity values from the separate manual-application ledger and at most 20 saved audit snapshots; MATCHING_HISTORY, partial evidence, no history, and a checklist REVIEWED event never assert application completion
criteria.manualApplication: manual apply/not-apply/clear are explicit append-only private ledger events with request UUID retry and current-event CAS; no message-index matching or ERP write
criteria.period: KST calendar dates converted to timezone-aware ISO, maximum7days
criteria.duplicates: source message identity de-duplication, never equals ERP committed
criteria.file: UTF8 Kakao export .txt <=2MiB, no external execution

crossYearFixture.description: Message text does not silently change selected ERP year/week; selected year explicit.

autoRefresh.initial: default-open inbox automatically GETs KST today only when year/week are valid, visible, online and no active ERP analysis/save
autoRefresh.scope: same loaded KST period only; date edits retain and label prior rows until explicit reload
autoRefresh.cursor: restart bounded period scan to catch late-arriving lower lexical message IDs
autoRefresh.preserve: input drafts, selected messages and review snapshots; stage incoming changes only while selection or review is open, otherwise display newest incoming rows immediately
autoRefresh.failure: preserve same-scope last good rows and show loading/failure/empty/incomplete status; no automatic LLM or ERP mutation

dnspyEvidence.note: This connector reads raw chat only; existing ERP analysis/save functions are not invoked automatically or modified.
